Lead, Direction B

Every page a Lead (shift lead) uses, on the phone and at 1440px, in the system you approved for Employees and Owners. Shown as James Ortiz, Lead and Barista at Northside Café & Bakery (Calle Loíza and Condado), on fictional data: Thursday, Nov 5, 3:42 PM, on shift 12 – 8 PM as the designated shift lead.

Pages with a capture have a Today switch showing the current Lead page (older v5 look). Nothing is built; this is the mock to approve first.

  • What a Lead has that an Employee doesn’tOnly two things in the code: Home’s Today’s team (Message today’s team, the existing Write an update for everyone on shift today) and the Shift lead marker on shifts they lead. Every other page and permission is the Employee’s.
  • So: the Employee pages, plus those twoPhone pages are the approved Employee Direction B pages with James’s data, the Shift lead chip, and Today’s team on Home. Desktop uses the Owner desktop shell with a Lead sidebar.
  • Tabs: Home, Schedule, Time, Pay, RequestsProposal: the Employee’s tabs (Pay only when statements are on), More on the avatar. Today’s Lead bar is Home, Schedule, Requests, Pay or Hours, More.
  • Data rules keptNo coworker names (a Lead gets no team list, only a recipient count when writing), no pay amounts on statements.

Delete account

Your NEVORA sign-in, not your job

What we delete

Your access ends right awayYou’re signed out on every device and can’t sign in again with your password or a passkey. Calendar links and device alerts stop.
Deleted within 30 calendar daysYour profile, sign-in details, notification subscriptions, calendar links and what you contributed. Once you confirm, you can’t cancel it in the app.

What Northside Café & Bakery keeps

Deleting your NEVORA account doesn’t end your employment or remove records your employer has to keep.

What may be kept

I understand my NEVORA account will be deleted and I won’t be able to sign in again.
